statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let v := fun (n : ℕ) => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2); let M := fun (X : ℕ) => (w X).sum v / (X : ℝ); let E := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun n => ¬ (n.Prime ∧ (n+2).Prime))).sum v / (X : ℝ); ∀ X : ℕ, 0 < X → E X < M X → ∃ n ∈ w X, n.Prime ∧ (n+2).Prime

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 差二窄窗 · TP-0003 · 从严格余量抽取同窗真素数对
plain_statement.en: New route · Gap-two windows · TP-0003 · Extract a genuine prime pair from a strict window surplus

brief.zh: 按两端的素性切分同一个有限和，消去相同的归一化。
brief.en: Partition the same finite sum by the two primality tests and cancel the common normalization.
